variants.name: Beef & Peas 150 g
variants.about_this_item:
SIMBA DOG PATÉ WITH BEEF & PEAS is a complete pet food for adult dogs of all sizes. Paté formulated with quality ingredients such as beef and peas, source of proteins and fibres, steam cooked to enhance their natural taste and stimulate your pet's daily appetite. The formulation has been developed with a specific combination of vitamins A-D3-E to meet the nutritional requirements of your pet's daily needs. No added colours or preservatives.

  • Complete pet food for adult dogs of all sizes
  • Paté, steam cooked
  • No added colours or preservatives
  • No cruelty test
  • Made in Italy
  • Pack size: 150 g
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: meat and animal derivatives (beef 7.5%), vegetables (peas 4.5%), minerals.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 9%, crude fibre 0.4%, crude fat 7.5%, crude ash 2.1%, moisture 81%.

Additives (nutritional additives/kg): Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 2500 IU, Vitamin D3 200 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 5 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions:
Instructions for use: To be served at room temperature. Leave always available to the animal fresh and clean water. Keep in cool and dry place. Refrigerate unused portion and consume within 2 days. Recommended daily feeding intakes: for an adult medium size dog (10 kg) with normal activity, give 600 grams of product, split into 2 daily meals. Do not open the alutray, if it is dented or swollen. Animal food, not suitable for human consumption.

Recommended daily feeding intakes (grams/day):

Weight of adult dog (kg)5-99-15
Daily feed (grams/day)350-550 g550-810 g
